label.explanation: account-svc v3.17.0 rolled out shortly before onset (lines 223, 230). Right after, account-svc started throwing a TypeError in the new formatter code, tagged with v3.17.0 (lines 248, 272, 285, 299). Only requests that hit that path fail, so most traffic still succeeds and the edge-proxy 500s are partial (lines 249, 267, 277, 297, 300, 308, 315, 320, 335, 341, 354, 374). It looks like bad input data, but the field is missing for any user without 'currency' — a code regression. Roll back to v3.16.5. Red herrings: line 250 (a client sending one invalid request, rejected correctly with a 400); line 114 (a certificate expiry reminder weeks out); line 220 (a config reload that changed nothing); line 216 (a single API client being rate-limited, which is the limiter working as intended).
